name: Returning the Lost Satchel
label: Quest
description: In Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar, the search for Maur Grimtotem ends with his satchel. You must carry it back to Rahauro on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar, the search for Maur Grimtotem ends with his satchel. You must carry it back to Rahauro on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.

Maur Grimtotem was slain by troggs in the fiery depths of Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar. Even in death, his arms clung to his personal satchel. Freeing it from his grip is the only clue to why a member of the Grimtotem clan entered the volcanic caverns beneath Thrall's capital.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You find a satchel under the body of the traveler. It is still gripped tightly in his arms as though he was trying to protect it while being attacked by the troggs.
Removing the satchel from his vice-like grip, you stow it with your own equipment and prepare to make your way out of the tunnels and back to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to find anything, friend? Any clues as to why one of her clansman had to die needlessly would be helpful.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Magatha told me that if you were successful in finding her clansman that you be given this. Please, take it in thanks.
